obligations: Map components, public interfaces and runtime call paths before changing a system.
Record important data structures, their owner, readers/writers, lifetime and invariants.
Model state transitions, concurrency, cancellation, failure propagation and resource cleanup where relevant.
Specify compatibility and migration requirements for public APIs, serialization and persisted state.
Build a small vertical slice across module boundaries before expanding independent components.
Use measured workload and bottleneck evidence to guide optimization rather than framework-specific guesses.
checks: Error injection, cancellation and cleanup when applicable
State consistency and concurrency invariants when applicable
Regression against a named baseline and realistic workload performance

seed_policy.reuse: Reuse mechanisms only after matching lifecycle and interface constraints; verify integration in the new system.
